newsitem.title: USA: Read-Rite says surprised by offer.
newsitem.headline: Read-Rite says surprised by offer.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp Chairman and Chief Executive Cyril Yansouni said in a statement that the company was "very surprised" to have received Applied Magnetic Corp proposal of a business combination.
Yansouni said in the statement that Read-Rite's board is reviewing the proposal "pursuant to its fiduciary responsibilities."

Under the deal, Read-Rite shareholders would receive 0.679 common shares of Applied Magnetic for each Read-Rite share. Based on a closing price of Applied Magnetic on February 21, the exchange ratio would produce a value of $37.50 per Read-Rite share.
The total value of the deal is about $1.76 billion.
